title: allthecodes settings
description: On-disk shape of settings.json (managed/user/project/local). Generated from src/config/settings.rs::settings_schema() — keep in sync via the `schema_file_matches_runtime` test.

statusLine.description: Scriptable status line. When `type` is `command`, the runtime pipes a JSON payload to the command's stdin and renders stdout as the footer. See docs/claude-code-configuration/customize-status-line.md.

outputStyle.description: Built-in: default, explanatory, learning. Custom names are loaded from <cwd>/.allthecodes/output-styles/<name>.md or <data_root>/output-styles/<name>.md.

viewMode.description: Default Rust TUI view mode at startup. Invalid persisted values fall back to prompt mode.

spinnerTips.description: Rust TUI spinner tip settings. Custom tips rotate while preserving the main spinner status text.

appIcon.description: Legacy Electron app icon setting. Accepted for compatibility, but unsupported by the Rust TUI and has no runtime effect.

autoStart.description: Legacy Electron auto-start setting. Accepted for compatibility, but unsupported by the Rust TUI and has no runtime effect.

startMinimized.description: Legacy Electron start-minimized setting. Accepted for compatibility, but unsupported by the Rust TUI and has no runtime effect.

minimizeToTray.description: Legacy Electron tray setting. Accepted for compatibility, but unsupported by the Rust TUI and has no runtime effect.

closeToTray.description: Legacy Electron tray setting. Accepted for compatibility, but unsupported by the Rust TUI and has no runtime effect.

quickChatHideOnBlur.description: Legacy Electron quick-chat setting. Accepted for compatibility, but unsupported by the Rust TUI and has no runtime effect.

quickChatInjectScreen.description: Legacy Electron quick-chat setting. Accepted for compatibility, but unsupported by the Rust TUI and has no runtime effect.

quickChatAmbient.description: Legacy Electron quick-chat setting. Accepted for compatibility, but unsupported by the Rust TUI and has no runtime effect.

autoApproveTools.description: Compatibility field only. It is not wired to Rust permissions and has no runtime effect; use permissionMode or permissions.defaultMode instead.

analyticsEnabled.description: Compatibility field only. Analytics collection is not implemented and this setting has no runtime effect.

autoCompact.description: Controls only threshold-triggered full auto-compact summarization. Local budget/snip/microcompact/context-collapse and prompt-too-long recovery still run when false.

compactThreshold.description: Context-window percentage that triggers full auto-compact summarization. Defaults to 80.

keepRecentMessages.description: Recent conversation turns retained by the snip stage. Defaults to 200.

effortLevel.description: Thinking budget label (low|medium|high|xhigh|auto|max) or a positive integer token count.

thinking.description: Anthropic thinking toggle. Object form accepts type=enabled/adaptive/disabled.

effort.description: Claude output effort. low/medium map to high; xhigh and any other non-empty value map to max.

output_config.description: Anthropic output_config passthrough. effort controls Claude-side reasoning strength.

model_reasoning_effort.description: Codex/OpenAI Responses reasoning effort. Directly maps to reasoning.effort for openai-codex requests.

teammateMode.description: Compatibility field only. Rust TUI teammate display modes are not implemented and this setting has no runtime effect.

claudeInChromeDefaultEnabled.description: Browser integration default consumed by allthecodes-browser, not by the Rust TUI.

memoryAutoRetrieve.description: Reserved for future memory runtime tuning; currently has no runtime effect.

memoryQueryRewriting.description: Reserved for future memory runtime tuning; currently has no runtime effect.

memoryMaxRetrieved.description: Reserved for future memory runtime tuning; currently has no runtime effect.

memorySimilarityThreshold.description: Reserved for future memory runtime tuning; currently has no runtime effect.

memoryAutoSummarize.description: Reserved for future memory runtime tuning; currently has no runtime effect.

memoryNightly.description: Reserved for future memory runtime tuning; currently has no runtime effect.

memorySleepTime.description: Reserved for future memory runtime tuning; currently has no runtime effect.

memoryTempTtl.description: Reserved for future memory runtime tuning; currently has no runtime effect.

memoryArchiveRetention.description: Reserved for future memory runtime tuning; currently has no runtime effect.

memoryToolModel.description: Reserved for future memory runtime tuning; currently has no runtime effect.

memoryEmbeddingModel.description: Reserved for future memory runtime tuning; currently has no runtime effect.

advisorModel.description: Advisor model consumed by supported native providers.

env.description: Environment variables applied at startup only when the variable is not already set by the shell, .env, or CI.
